title: Super General 55" 4K smart TV (CVTE board TP.SK708D.PC821, Amlogic T972, product x30a4, panel HV550QUB),
notes:
Super General 55" 4K smart TV (CVTE board TP.SK708D.PC821, Amlogic T972, product x30a4, panel HV550QUB),
Android 9 (API 28), firmware x30a4-userdebug 9 PPR1.180610.011 20210518 (CVTE MD_CVTE_OVERSEA_T972_9_0_1G_STARKOS,
build 20210518_103433), Saudi Arabia. 1 GB RAM (low_ram), armeabi-v7a only.
Not Google TV: CVTE's own launcher (com.cvte.tv.launcher.highend) and settings. The build fingerprint is spoofed
(google/shamu/...), so match the board name (ro.cvte.boardname) instead.
Tested on one set for a day, reboot-checked; launcher half done with a third-party launcher (see README.md).
Setup steps (ADB, remote access, Play Services) and troubleshooting: README.md in this folder.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/super-general-cvte-t972/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/super-general-cvte-t972/debloat.txt com.cvte.tv.launcher.highend
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

ADB: switch to a source (TV or HDMI) first, then MENU 1 1 4 7 -> DEBUG -> ADB ENABLE. Network ADB on 5555,
survives reboots. userdebug firmware.

Google Play Services shipped disabled by the system (enabled=3): `pm enable com.google.android.gms` so Google Play
works; it stayed on across a reboot.

KEEP: com.cvte.tv.globalui (.InputSourceActivity, the source menu), com.cvte.tv.setting (TV settings, quick menu),
com.cvte.tiflauncher, com.cvte.tv.api.impl (TIF player and the remote's hotkey service), com.cvte.tvservice,
com.cvte.tv.remotedebug, com.droidlogic.* (TV input, Bluetooth remote, Miracast). Factory: com.cvte.fac.menu,
com.cvte.factory.at, com.cvte.factory.service; never launch these.
Adware: the "com.sdk.hades" SDK (starts on boot and screen-on, background jobs, internet). Both were installed
silently; neither appears in the TV's app list.
